Osaifu-Keitai App (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.felicanetworks.mfm.main)
A digital wallet app for Osaifu-Keitai brand.
It does not appear to be related to the FeliCa core functionality, but is required for services under the Osaifu-Keitai brand, such as iD and Mobile Suica.
For details, please check the app description (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.felicanetworks.mfm.main) on Play Store.
